queries.query: Hailed a standard yellow cab from Chicago O'Hare terminal to the downtown hotel where the regional sales summit is being hosted.
Booked roundtrip basic coach airfare on Delta from Boston to Atlanta for the Q3 operations review meeting three weeks before the flight.
Grabbed a quick breakfast sandwich and coffee at Starbucks during a one-day trip to our Hartford warehouse location.
Purchased an ergonomic wireless split keyboard and vertical mouse for my daily remote engineering workstation.
Paid for high-speed in-room Wi-Fi connection for 3 nights at the Marriott during a business visit to the Dallas client office.
Parked in the airport economy long-term surface lot for 4 days while attending the annual tech conference in Las Vegas.
Submitted a receipt for a double IPA craft beer ordered at the hotel lobby bar after the client dinner concluded.
Reimbursing a municipal parking meter ticket received while parked outside the customer site during an afternoon meeting.
Purchased an in-flight movie and watched pay-per-view films in the hotel room after work hours.
Booked an urgent one-way plane ticket 4 days before traveling to fix a critical production outage at our Phoenix data center.
Reserved an Uber Black premium sedan from the airport to the hotel because regular rides had long queues.
Drove my personal Honda Civic 180 miles roundtrip to deliver backup hardware to a customer branch site.
Claimed 25 miles per day for my daily drive between my home in Jersey City and the company HQ office in Manhattan.
Stayed 2 nights at the Hyatt Regency in downtown San Francisco at a nightly room rate of $240 before taxes for a partner summit.
Booked a standard hotel room in Cleveland for 2 nights at $235 per night due to an ongoing medical convention.
Hosted a business dinner for 4 people (myself + 3 Acme Corp client stakeholders); total meal was $360 including tax and 18% tip.
Dinner with 2 prospective partners to review vendor RFP responses; invoice came to $340 for the 3 of us.
Full day meals during overnight travel in Denver: Breakfast ($18), Lunch ($24), and Dinner ($45), totaling $87.
Combined food total for a single day of travel came to $125 across room service and lunch.
Paid for the rental car company's prepaid full tank of gas option and supplementary liability insurance at counter check-in.
Hotel dry cleaning and laundry service bill incurred on the 6th day of an 8-day multi-city training roadshow.
Submitted a 2-day business trip hotel laundry invoice for shirt pressing before an executive breakfast.
Monthly subscription for GitHub Copilot Pro and JetBrains IDE tools utilized for daily software development tasks.
Monthly enterprise workspace AI assistant subscription claimed without submitting IT security approval ticket.
Overnight expedited courier delivery of signed commercial contracts to counterparty counsel before the fiscal deadline.
Upgraded domestic flight from Seattle to San Francisco to First Class out of personal pocket and submitted full ticket.
Missed the hotel cancellation deadline by 2 hours due to a delayed client meeting, incurring a one-night room penalty charge.
Team celebratory dinner with 5 colleagues after product launch; we split the $500 total check onto two employee cards ($250 each).
Hosted 2 VP clients for dinner ($180 total food), but the receipt includes an itemized $65 Cabernet Sauvignon wine bottle.
Took a 45-mile Uber from Dulles Airport during an intense snowstorm; surge pricing pushed the fare to $84.
Booked flight from London to New York 8 weeks in advance in standard economy, but did not request VP approval beforehand.
Paid an $85 Economy Plus extra-legroom upgrade fee on a 5-hour domestic flight to ensure workspace for drafting an urgent client RFP.
Spouse accompanied me on a 4-day executive conference in Miami; submitted additional meal and hotel supplement charges.
Rented a Premium Full-Size SUV in Denver because mountain road weather required 4-wheel drive to reach the client facility.
Purchased a 4K external display ($170) and a standing desk riser ($110) for remote work, totaling $280 for the year.
Paid a $50 extra legroom seat selection charge on a 4-hour flight due to a recent knee injury (medical note attached).
Used airport terminal valet parking for 3 days ($105 total) because all long-term economy surface lots were at 100% capacity upon arrival.
Ordered mini-bar water bottles, chocolate, and energy drinks from the hotel room during late-night proposal preparation.
Dinner for single traveler during transit in Frankfurt; bill converted to $48 USD for a schnitzel and soft beverage.
Overnighted critical legal deposition documents to federal court via courier, costing $65 with urgent courier receipt attached.
